purpose: Define the live peer-directory layout state for departments/ while keeping department induction separate from bare root normalization.

layout_rule.statement: All governed departments shall exist as peer directories beneath departments/. Peer-directory presence does not by itself imply inducted department status.
layout_rule.induction_boundary: A peer root may exist in placeholder form until its local SSOT, local AGENTS.md, and induction-specific routing artifacts are completed.
layout_rule.temporary_exemption_rule: For planned departments only, a placeholder README.md satisfies the peer-root requirement until the later induction debt is discharged.

completion_rule: Every department in the live department registry must have a peer directory beneath departments/.
Placeholder roots must explicitly declare that induction remains pending where applicable.
Later induction debts must not be auto-closed by peer-root creation alone.
